evidence_items.explanation: The interview documents missing control over continuity between separately generated shots. It supports the specific reliability concern, but does not establish that every movie use was impractical.

evidence_items.explanation: Trillo describes a completed Sora music video, substantial selection of generated clips, and some conventional post-production. This challenges an absolute claim of no usefulness, but a stylized music video does not establish reliable production of the movie scenes described in the contract.
